title: Page tree (P1 draft 0.1.0)
description: One infographic page as a tree of seven node kinds: Page, Frame, Node, Text, Facts, Checks, Selects. Every number a page prints is a fact reference (fact:<key>[.n|.t|.tick<i>]) whose query uses the existing op language of next_facts.rs (value, mean, peak, low, last, count, rest, n, zeros, unrowed, excluded over rows; share, change, times, minus, plus over two facts). Selects declare which codes a page chose and why, so the core can recheck the choice from the rows; Checks declare the stop lines and page checks. Field names follow the old specs where they exist (title, dek, kicker, alt, span, labels, children) without $ref to them (ADR P1-1, option C). Draft: no code reads this file yet.

Code.description: A data code or key: a dimension code (SE, EU27_2020, N900H, BA100), a table id, a year or month as the rows give it. Never words: no CJK, no space.

FactKey.description: A declared fact key, or a family member <family>.<code>.

FactRef.description: Where a printed number is in the ledger: fact:<key>, fact:<key>.n (bare), fact:<key>.t (its period), fact:<key>.tick<i>.

SeriesRef.description: A fetched row by its src.

LedgerRef.description: Any ledger entry a text run may print: a fact, a name row (name:zh_names:<kind>:<code>, name:frames:<relation>, name:unit_short_zh:<unit>, name:catalogue:<table>:title), a period or a record cell.

Knob.description: A visual or layer-1 knob by its registered name and the value it had for this page (knobs.json, catalogue.knob).

Const.description: A program constant by its name and value (NARROW_TOP, COLUMN_DEC): never printed.

Filter.description: dimension -> one code or a list of codes (next_facts select).

Query.description: A row set: table, filter, and the dimension it runs by.

scoped.description: The program narrowed the main's places: texts use their scoped wording.

scope.description: hero.scope: the aggregate the drawn places are members of, and the fact counting them.

request.description: The user's request, whole, and its sha256 (hex of its UTF-8 bytes): what a quote run is held to.

fragment.description: Part of a page only (a fixture without the rows for the rest). Recognised only for files under examples/fixtures/ (the fixture directory); anywhere else a page holding this key fails validation. The node registry is not enforced on a fixture, and its publish gate is always closed: publish must be false, and the publish gate (the check the page tree core makes before publishing) refuses every page holding this key.

Finding.description: The dek's finding (finding_of) and its headline, each plain and scoped; the subject is the accent.

requires_facts.description: The headline prints only when these facts are declared (a level headline needs times).

Text.description: Words as runs. A literal run holds no digit: every number is a fact or ledger run.

origin.description: Who wrote the literal runs: program constants (counted by the ratchet), the word table, the text step (model words, placeholders kept), the registry.

w.description: Literal words. The schema refuses digits, the ratio words and a numeral before a ratio word or a percent sign; the full rule is the core's next_flow::worded_number, which the page tree core (src/next_tree.rs) ports with its constants (NUMERALS, RATIO_AFTER, RATIO_WORDS, NUMBER_FREE, QUANTITY_BEFORE at 4494b5fd) over the Text's runs joined, the other runs standing as placeholders.
w.pattern: ^(?!.*(一半|过半|大半|半数|减半|近半|逾半|超半|翻番|翻倍|数倍|[零〇一二两三四五六七八九十百千万亿几]\s*(倍|分之|个百分点|%|％)))[^0-9０-９]*$

quote.description: A digit string of the request (10-31 release: only the request's own digit strings): the page tree core holds it to Page.request.text.

Frame.description: A group of children in order (z order, reading order); a recipe's page is its outermost frame.

Node.description: One registered node (knobs.json) with its knobs and its bindings. Binds and items carry codes, refs and select ids only; geometry carries layout numbers that never print. A Node may hold child Nodes (composite); shared knobs are declared once on the outer Frame or Node.

children.description: Nodes packed into this node (a composite / smart object: layers nested as one node that shows only a few knobs). Panels of a grid are children.

panel.description: The facet code this node draws (one panel of a grid).

items_for.description: The select whose result the items are, one item per code in order (checked).

Item.description: One drawn thing of a node: a bar, a circle, a note, a flow, a mark, a big number, a merged node.

Facts.description: The page's data: the tables, the rows (each once, by src), the declared facts, the formats, the names. The core recomputes every fact from these rows (next_facts recheck).

named.description: name row -> its text (knobs.named), held to it in the ledger.

conditional.description: Facts declared only under a data condition, with the rule, so an absent or reordered fact is rechecked too (map <c>_ch only from a t0 value above 0; a gap's a/b larger first; a big number only when its fact is declared).

assets.description: Run-local files a node reads (knobs.shapes: the ring shapes), by a relative name and its hash.

dec_rule.description: How dec was derived, so the core can recheck it: held_decimals = the most decimals the named rows hold, capped by max (COLUMN_DEC, POINTS_DEC, COMPOSITION_GAP_DEC); fixed = as written.

FactQuery.description: The op language of next_facts.rs, one variant per op group. op absent means value.

oneOf.title: value / family (each)
peak / low / last over a window
mean within a period prefix
rest: the codes of `by` past the first `skip`, largest first
n: how many codes of `by`; zeros: how many rows of 0
unrowed: pairs of held codes with no row
excluded: pairs the registry leaves out
count: members whose a/b is above a line
share / change / times / minus / plus of two facts (minus with each: a family of differences)

Selects.description: Every choice of codes the page makes, declared with its rule and its result, so the core can recompute the result from Facts.rows (plan section 4 item 1). A select's result that the core cannot recompute is a refusal, never a pass. Which selects a node must carry is not the page's choice: node-registry.json lists, per node, the selects and checks it needs, and the page tree core refuses a page that lacks one or swaps its kind.

Tie.description: What a tie does: order by code, keep the first seen, or (printed) two values the page prints alike tie, and the outcome is silence (no finding) or the place's own value.

oneOf.title: rank: order codes of `by` by their value (or change between two times)
top_n: the first n of an ordered select

rest.description: The codes past the first n, in order (named under the picture).

oneOf.title: take: one code at an end of an ordered select, under a sign condition
drop_replace: a candidate that fails a sum check is left out and the next in order takes its place

less.description: exclude_codes selects applied before the sum

unread.description: Candidates never reached once the target was met.

oneOf.title: zero_parts: a part declared zero in a bar: every code of the group has a row and all are 0

facts.description: group -> the zeros fact counting its rows of 0

oneOf.title: empty_parts: a part with no row (or 0 with a code missing) is empty, never said as 0
exclude_codes: codes of a group taken out of one place's sum because the total does not hold them (F3: BA100 for PT); the gap must equal their value

value.description: fact: the excluded codes' value, printed in the note

oneOf.title: merge_below: codes of a side under a share of all flows merge into one other node when two or more do
window: a months span back from a series' last month, clipped to the page window
table_pick: a table chosen for the question is held to rules (a table with no groups refused; a fetch of no row refused once)
registry_list: codes a registry gives (flow_asked, flow_excluded, members, composition groups); rechecked by reading the registry
set_op: codes of one select less another's, or two in order (sankey empty = registered less held; composition others = candidates past the bars then the places never fetched)
given: codes an earlier stage chose (the run record, the shape step), copied in; rechecked by reading that record, never by trusting this list
named_rule: a rule from a closed list the core implements once (topic-free), for choices the kinds above do not cover yet

Checks.description: Stop lines and page checks. stop: the page stops with the why; silence: the finding is dropped, the page goes on; refuse_once: the model is told the allowed values and an example, a second failure stops; page_fail: a page check that must pass before publish. The required ones per node are in node-registry.json (enforced).

oneOf.title: max_dropped: more than num/den of the target dropped stops
fill_after_drop: once one is dropped, the bars must still reach the target
row_exists: a row each code of a select must have (the total row; a month; a flow above zero; two ends)
named: every code of a kind the page prints has a reviewed name in the name table; one code, one name
tolerance_fixed: a tolerance is the registered knob's, never widened
page_check: a check the published page must pass (page_checks)

declared.description: select ids whose declarations the check accepts as said (zero_parts)

oneOf.title: other program stop lines, one kind each, topic-free

Record.description: What stays with the flow for the run's record (not sent to the leaf, not printed).

Shared.description: Fields declared once on an outer Frame or Node and inherited by every Node under it (panel grid, combined views): category order, legend, value scale, accent, palette, knobs. A node under it must not restate any of them, under the same name or another one: the page tree core refuses a child bind or knob named as a shared field, a child value that lists two or more codes of the shared category order, an items_for other than the shared order, and two accents that differ anywhere on the page.

legend.description: One legend for all panels: an entry per category, its name from the labels.

scale.description: One value axis for all panels: its top a fact, so panels compare.

accent.description: The one place every node under this frame marks (R3): a select, declared once.

palette.description: code -> colour, one map for every node under this frame.

by.description: The dimension one panel per code of (facet).

panels.description: The facet codes in panel order, a select's result.

SelectRef.description: A select's recomputed result: select:<id> (all of it), select:<id>[i] (one, negative from the end), select:<id>.<key> (one entry of a map result). Anywhere a chosen code is used (filters, names, items, binds, checks) it is written as this, never as the literal code: the core substitutes its own recomputed result, so a fact or a drawn item cannot drift from the choice (lint: a literal code that is a member of a select result is refused).

KnobValue.description: A knob's value: a number (layout, never printed), a word-free option name, or a colour.
